subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app stay Overview/companion-node first, add an explicit chat-first mode/default, or move this direction entirely into the mobile RFC process before accepting PR slices?
rationale: Current main has real Android chat improvements but no accepted product decision for a chat-first launch surface or broad audio/video/fullscreen media scope.

options.title: Keep companion-first default with focused slices
options.body: Keep Overview/Home as the default and invite narrow, proof-backed Android PRs for specific chat entry, media rendering, and connectivity improvements.

options.title: Approve a chat-first Android mode
options.body: Define the mode/default, migration behavior, setup flow, and real-device proof requirements before accepting implementation PRs.

options.title: Move broad direction to the RFC
options.body: Once maintainers confirm openclaw/rfcs#28 as the venue, close this issue with links and preserve the Android fork references there.

recommendation.title: Keep companion-first default with focused slices
recommendation.body: Keep Overview/Home as the default and invite narrow, proof-backed Android PRs for specific chat entry, media rendering, and connectivity improvements.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android app is explicitly routed to @obviyus in CONTRIBUTING.md and apps/android/README.md, and the decision changes Android app product shape.
